title: vitex trifolia var. trifoliolata
intro: Vitex trifolia var. trifoliolata, commonly known as Chaste tree, is a plant species in the Lamiaceae family, native to tropical regions of Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including menstrual disorders and anxiety, due to its health benefits of regulating the menstrual cycle, reducing stress, and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Vitex trifolia var. trifoliolata are attributed to its ability to act as a uterine stimulant, nervine, and mild anxiolytic, which helps in managing hormonal imbalances and alleviating symptoms of premenstrual syndrome (PMS). The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
